umbraco-recent-pages.title: Recently changed pages
umbraco-recent-pages.sql: SELECT LOWER(CAST(n.uniqueId AS VARCHAR(36))) AS PAGE_KEY, n.id AS PAGE_ID, v.text AS NAME, {ContentPath} AS PATH, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.userName, ''), u.userLogin, 'Unknown user') AS EDITED_BY, {EditedAt} AS EDITED_AT, v.versionDate AS VERSION_DATE FROM umbracoNode n JOIN umbracoDocument d ON d.nodeId = n.id JOIN umbracoContentVersion v ON v.nodeId = n.id AND v."current" = 1 LEFT JOIN umbracoUser u ON u.id = v.userId WHERE n.trashed = 0 AND {{RowRestriction}}

PATH.helpText: The full content tree path, including this page.

EDITED_AT.helpText: When the latest version was saved, including unpublished changes.

umbraco-members.title: Umbraco Members
umbraco-members.sql: SELECT n.id AS MEMBER_ID, n.text AS NAME, m.LoginName AS LOGIN, m.Email AS EMAIL, m.isApproved AS APPROVED, m.lastLoginDate AS LAST_LOGIN, n.createDate AS CREATED FROM cmsMember m JOIN umbracoNode n ON n.id = m.nodeId

umbraco-media.title: Umbraco Media
umbraco-media.sql: SELECT n.id AS MEDIA_ID, n.text AS NAME, tn.text AS MEDIA_TYPE, NULLIF(CONCAT(p10.text, CASE WHEN p10.id IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' END, p9.text, CASE WHEN p9.id IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' END, p8.text, CASE WHEN p8.id IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' END, p7.text, CASE WHEN p7.id IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' END, p6.text, CASE WHEN p6.id IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' END, p5.text, CASE WHEN p5.id IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' END, p4.text, CASE WHEN p4.id IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' END, p3.text, CASE WHEN p3.id IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' END, p2.text, CASE WHEN p2.id IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' END, p1.text), '') AS FOLDER, mv.path AS FILE_PATH, CONCAT('{SiteRoot}', mv.path) AS FILE_URL, ext.varcharValue AS EXTENSION, CAST(bytes.varcharValue AS BIGINT) AS SIZE_BYTES, w.intValue AS WIDTH, h.intValue AS HEIGHT, n.createDate AS UPLOADED, cu.userName AS UPLOADED_BY, cu.userEmail AS UPLOADED_BY_EMAIL, v.versionDate AS MODIFIED, mu.userName AS MODIFIED_BY, CASE WHEN n.trashed = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS IN_RECYCLE_BIN, n.uniqueId AS MEDIA_KEY FROM umbracoNode n JOIN umbracoContent c ON c.nodeId = n.id JOIN cmsContentType ct ON ct.nodeId = c.contentTypeId AND ct.alias <> 'Folder' JOIN umbracoNode tn ON tn.id = ct.nodeId JOIN umbracoContentVersion v ON v.nodeId = n.id AND v."current" = 1 LEFT JOIN umbracoMediaVersion mv ON mv.id = v.id LEFT JOIN umbracoUser cu ON cu.id = n.nodeUser LEFT JOIN umbracoUser mu ON mu.id = v.userId LEFT JOIN umbracoNode p1 ON p1.id = n.parentId AND p1.id > 0 LEFT JOIN umbracoNode p2 ON p2.id = p1.parentId AND p2.id > 0 LEFT JOIN umbracoNode p3 ON p3.id = p2.parentId AND p3.id > 0 LEFT JOIN umbracoNode p4 ON p4.id = p3.parentId AND p4.id > 0 LEFT JOIN umbracoNode p5 ON p5.id = p4.parentId AND p5.id > 0 LEFT JOIN umbracoNode p6 ON p6.id = p5.parentId AND p6.id > 0 LEFT JOIN umbracoNode p7 ON p7.id = p6.parentId AND p7.id > 0 LEFT JOIN umbracoNode p8 ON p8.id = p7.parentId AND p8.id > 0 LEFT JOIN umbracoNode p9 ON p9.id = p8.parentId AND p9.id > 0 LEFT JOIN umbracoNode p10 ON p10.id = p9.parentId AND p10.id > 0 LEFT JOIN umbracoPropertyData ext ON ext.versionId = v.id AND ext.propertyTypeId IN (SELECT id FROM cmsPropertyType WHERE Alias = 'umbracoExtension') LEFT JOIN umbracoPropertyData bytes ON bytes.versionId = v.id AND bytes.propertyTypeId IN (SELECT id FROM cmsPropertyType WHERE Alias = 'umbracoBytes') LEFT JOIN umbracoPropertyData w ON w.versionId = v.id AND w.propertyTypeId IN (SELECT id FROM cmsPropertyType WHERE Alias = 'umbracoWidth') LEFT JOIN umbracoPropertyData h ON h.versionId = v.id AND h.propertyTypeId IN (SELECT id FROM cmsPropertyType WHERE Alias = 'umbracoHeight') WHERE UPPER(n.nodeObjectType) = 'B796F64C-1F99-4FFB-B886-4BF4BC011A9C'

FOLDER.helpText: Folders from the top of the media library down to the item, up to ten levels; empty for items at the root.

FILE_PATH.helpText: The file under wwwroot. Click to open it.

SIZE_BYTES.helpText: Size of the uploaded file in bytes.

UPLOADED.helpText: When the media item was created.

MODIFIED.helpText: When the item was last saved: a replaced file, a rename, a move.
